t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ntele kimbangi, ô Nzambi ami, i Ngeye wa mvanga mpasi vo yakuzaya ye kuzitisanga mpe. Ye buabu, ngieti zaya vo lebakana kuami i lulendo luaku, bumputu buami i kimvuama kiaku. Kakuena Nzambi ya nkaka ko, ye mu ntangu a mpasi Ngeye wusadisanga, kadi Ngeye wena mu Ngeye kibeni.
